subject: Lumen Health - Marketplace renewal & accelerated uplift coordination

Subject: Lumen Health - renewal window + proposed uplift cadence

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached an updated private offer (v3) that adds the 20% capacity uplift you asked for and shortens the acceptance window so you can start leveraging the additional capacity on 11/01. Highlights:

- 24-month renewal term starting 2027-11-01
- +20% committed capacity at the same per-token rate (no change to unit pricing)
- Billing: two-tranche invoice (50% upfront, 50% at month 13) to match your fiscal cadence
- SLA: standard marketplace SLA with an optional 4-hour incident response add-on (see SOW)

Action items:
1) Review the attached PDF and SOW spreadsheet and confirm procurement email for PO routing.
2) If legal needs redlines, please loop in procurement@lumenhealth.com and I’ll coordinate with ours.
3) If you want to accelerate the second tranche to month 9 instead of 13, we can run that through finance but I need a sign-off by 10/20.

I copied Ben and Jonas for billing and acceptance playbook support.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Lumen_PrivateOffer_v3.pdf (Private Offer, 8 pages); SOW-Lumen-Uplift.xlsx (spreadsheet, billing/SLAs)

Thanks Grace — this looks good at a high level. A few quick clarifications before I route to procurement:

- Can you confirm the expected monthly token allotment after the 20% uplift (we need the exact numbers for our budget owner)?
- Is the 4-hour incident response an add-on we sign once, or does it apply per incident?
- We prefer invoices to follow calendar quarters; your two-tranche suggestion works if the first invoice can be dated 11/01 and the second on 01/01 of the next year. Is that possible?

I'll loop procurement/Chris once I have those answers.

Best,
Sara
Director, AI Platforms — Lumen Health

Grace —

Numbers below: base committed tokens = 120M tokens/month; 20% uplift -> 144M tokens/month.

- Upfront tranche (50%): invoice on 2027-11-01 for months 1–12 equivalent spend. We can set the invoice date to 11/01 as Sara requested.
- Second tranche: typical is month 13 date, but finance can accept 01/01/2028 as the second invoice date (calendar quarter alignment) if Lumen signs by 10/20. That keeps GAAP alignment for them.

On the 4-hour incident response: that is a subscription add-on billed monthly; it is a standing service (not per-incident). I added a one-line blurb to the SOW.

I'll prep a billing note for procurement that explains the invoice dates and accounting treatment.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
